description: Decide what to post. Turn something trending, or one rough idea, into a per-platform set of drafts — using hooks that earn replies and saves, post structures measured against top-performing accounts, and what actually spreads on each network. Decides WHAT to post; the postey skill decides how it is written and publishes it.
